options: Charge every user a fee before showing ads only.
Fetch recent posts from people the user follows.
Delete all followers older than one day automatically.
Convert the social graph into a CDN edge certificate.

questions.question: Fan-out on write means:
options: Computing the feed only when the user opens the app in real production systems at scale.
Pushing a new post into followers’ feed caches/stores at write time.
Never storing posts so feeds are always empty in real production systems at scale.
Sending each post via postal mail before any digital write in real production systems at scale.

Load balancers drop packets only for famous accounts in real production systems at scale.
